# Upgrades This guide will explain Upgrade Modules and how they can be used to upgrade items and machines in a variety of ways.
## View Available Upgrades To view what upgrades an item or machine has available you must stand close to it and press the 'Upgrades' button under the examine dropdown of the right click menu. If 'Upgrades' does not appear then it may not have any available upgrades.
If you can examine the upgrades it will list the available upgrades along with [bold]the upgrade module type required to apply it[/bold]. When the upgrades say 'choose one' only one type of upgrade can be applied before locking the others out.
## Upgrade Modules Upgrade Modules are available through the Rumored Imports with every upgrade module having a specific pattern that it relates to. Every upgrade requires a specific type of module to apply it.
## Applying the Upgrade Modules Hold the upgrade module in your active hand and choose the "Upgrade" option from the right click menu of the device.
## Upgradeable Items and Machines Most upgrades can be applied [bold]up to two times[/bold] to the same item or machine.
### Equipment [bold]Backpacks[/bold] and [bold]storage belts[/bold] can gain extra storage space. [bold]Helmets, hats, armor and jumpsuits[/bold] can gain extra armor against a specific type of damage. [bold]Tools[/bold] can be made to work faster. [bold]Gas tanks[/bold] can hold more gas. [bold]Handheld mass scanners[/bold] can gain extra range.
### Machines [bold]Lathes[/bold] can be made to print faster. [bold]Microwaves[/bold] can hold more and cook faster. [bold]Reagent grinders[/bold] can be made to work faster. [bold]Lockers, crates and washing machines[/bold] can hold more. [bold]Gas canisters[/bold] can hold more gas.
### Engineering [bold]APCs[/bold] can handle a higher maximum load. [bold]SMES units[/bold] can store more power. [bold]Thermo-electric generators[/bold] and [bold]radiation collectors[/bold] can generate more power. [bold]Telecommunication servers[/bold] can broadcast over a longer range.
### Shuttles [bold]Radar and shuttle consoles[/bold] can gain extra radar range.
## Faction Upgrades Upgrade Modules are also required to level up a faction. For more information see the 'Faction Modification' guidepage.
